attribution.title: Connor Hill road heading south. - geograph.org.uk - 219688
attribution.author: Sharon Loxton
attribution.description: Conor Hill road heading south. Taken from by Pedlar's lake, this shows the winding Conor Hill road heading south west towards Conor Pass.  This is the only section of the road which has not been widened, and is a notorious bottleneck as so many people drive over the pass to see the marvellous views the road offers of both the north and the south of the western Dingle Peninsula.
